role: USABLE_WITH_LIMITATIONS dataset (Phase 3.2-J.3, promoted from KEEP_CANDIDATE_ONLY per J.2). Provides a 6-category evidence taxonomy including a first-class abstention category. NOT registered under phase3/evaluation/datasets/profile.schema.json (frozen to the 4 canonical-active datasets) -- a shape-compatible sibling profile, same as PerLTQA's.

processed_files.note: Only the 18-file committed raw/ sample's normalized output is present in-repo; full-corpus normalized output was generated and audited externally in J.2 (see reports/evidence_audit_j2_data.json) but not committed, per J.1/J.2's disclosed ~14.7GB corpus size limit.

inspection_method.description: Full-corpus scan (not sample-based) performed in Phase 3.2-J.2: all 75,336 task records / 144,598 evidence spans scanned via the deterministic resolution waterfall. This profile's in-repo record counts reflect the committed 18-file sample; full-corpus numbers are cited from reports/evidence_audit_j2_data.json, never restated as if independently re-verified here.

stable_id.reason: Every message's ADAPTER_DERIVED_IDENTITY is anchored to the source's own native conversations[i].id field (verified globally unique, 0 reuse across 74,391+ conversations, J.2) plus a resolved message index.

unique_id.reason: conversation.id verified globally unique (J.2); message_index is unique within its own conversation by construction (a list position).

content_available.reason: Every message carries non-empty speaker/text fields (full scan, J.2).

timestamped.reason: Zero timestamp/date/time fields exist anywhere in evidence_questions/ messages or conversations (full scan, J.2).

session_linked.reason: Each conversation is a session-like unit (conversations[i].id); no separate explicit session_id distinguishing multiple sessions within one conversation.

typed_foundation_or_derived.reason: No explicit type tag; every message is a foundation memory by construction (no parent-edge structure exists).

explicit_parent_ids_present.reason: Full scan, J.1/J.2: zero parent_ids/equivalent_to fields anywhere in the source.
explicit_parent_ids_present.grounding: phase3/datasets/candidates/convomem/normalized/memory_records.jsonl (parent_ids field, literal NOT_PROVIDED_BY_SOURCE on every record)

explicit_task_records.reason: normalized/task_records.jsonl exists, one record per evidence_item.

separate_from_memory.reason: task_records.jsonl is a physically separate file with a disjoint schema from memory_records.jsonl.

query_field.reason: Every task record carries a non-empty agent_visible.question string.

gold_answer_field.reason: Full scan (J.2): 0/75,336 null or empty answers.

task_id_field.reason: Every task record carries a source_record_id distinct in shape from any memory identity.

session_or_conversation_id.reason: category/evidence_count_bucket link a task to its persona file; per-message conversation.id is only resolvable via evidence_resolution locations, not a standalone task-level field.

evidence_availability.reason: 97.0% of individual evidence spans (140,225/144,598, full-corpus scan, J.2) resolve to a real ADAPTER_DERIVED_IDENTITY; 94.8% of items are fully resolved. The remaining 2.3% zero-resolved items (plus a small ambiguous/too-short residual) have no evidence-ID gold basis at all -- PARTIAL, not AVAILABLE, at the dataset level, matching J.2's own explicit non-100% framing.

answer_availability.reason: 0/75,336 null/empty answers (full-corpus scan, J.2) -- answer availability is fully independent of evidence resolution (J.2 section 13).

provenance_availability.reason: Every normalized record carries source_revision (huggingface_dataset_sha) pointing to the pinned HF revision.

lineage_availability.reason: No parent_ids edges exist anywhere (full scan) -- no lineage graph to walk.

equivalence_availability.reason: No equivalent_to edges exist anywhere (full scan).
equivalence_availability.grounding: phase3/datasets/candidates/convomem/normalized/memory_records.jsonl (equivalent_to field, literal NOT_PROVIDED_BY_SOURCE on every record)

temporal_information.reason: Zero timestamp fields exist anywhere (full scan, J.2); changing_evidence's 'facts evolve' semantics rely on message order only -- the same temporal kind MSC/Conversation Chronicles already provide, not TIMESTAMPED_ABSOLUTE.

RECALL_AT_K.reason: ADAPTER_DERIVED_IDENTITY evidence IDs resolve for 94.8% of items (full corpus); NOT_ATTEMPTABLE for the residual zero-resolved items, which must carry an empty gold_evidence_ids list (never a fabricated one).

STRICT_TSR.reason: gold_evidence_ids are real ADAPTER_DERIVED_IDENTITY values for resolved spans; strict_tsr()'s canonical set-intersection definition applies unmodified; UNDEFINED_EMPTY_GOLD for zero-resolved items, never a fabricated 0.

SELECTION_CAPACITY_DIAGNOSTICS.reason: Requires a gold_id, available for resolved items.

REDUNDANCY.reason: Identity-duplicate-only, needs only a selected-id sequence.

EQUIVALENCE_DIAGNOSTICS.reason: No equivalent_to edges exist (full scan, 0 matches).

PROVENANCE_VALIDATION.reason: Every record has a source_revision pointer; provenance validation does not require parent_ids.

LINEAGE_DIAGNOSTICS.reason: No parent_ids edges exist (full scan, 0 matches).

AGENT_ANSWER_CORRECTNESS.reason: 0/75,336 null/empty answers (full scan); fully independent of evidence resolution.

MEMORY_CONTRIBUTION.reason: Requires gold answers (present, 100%) and evidence (present for 94.8% of items).

RETRIEVAL_UTILIZATION.reason: Needs only selected/used_memory_ids from an AgentExecutionResult; no dataset-specific gold dependency.

FAILURE_STAGE_CLASSIFICATION.reason: Requires gold_evidence_ids (present for 94.8% of items) and an expected_answer (present, 100%).

NO_MEMORY.reason: build_agent_visible_context needs only task_id/question, both present.

GOLD_EVIDENCE.reason: Gold evidence content assemblable from encoded evidence IDs -> per-message memory lookup, for the 94.8%-resolved majority.

RETRIEVED_MEMORY.reason: Requires a real candidate-discovery/reranking/selection pipeline, not implemented anywhere in Phase 3.2.

DERIVED_MEMORY_AVAILABLE.reason: No derived memories exist (no parent_ids anywhere).

CONFLICTING_MEMORY_AVAILABLE.reason: No conflicts_with edges exist anywhere in the source.

adapter_requirements: A candidate-discovery + reranking + selection pipeline over normalized/memory_records.jsonl -- not implemented anywhere yet.

An explicit policy decision on whether the 2.3% zero-resolved items should be excluded from evidence-based metric aggregation entirely, or included with an explicit NOT_ATTEMPTED marker per case -- this profile does not decide the policy.
limitations: USABLE_WITH_LIMITATIONS, not PROMOTE_TO_USABLE: licensing remains LICENSE_UNRESOLVED (see manifests/registry_entry.json) -- this status must not be silently upgraded regardless of technical integration success.

Only the committed 18-file raw/ sample is present in this repository; this profile's in-repo record counts reflect that sample, while metric_support/evidence_availability reasoning cites the externally-audited full-corpus numbers from J.2.
2.3% of items (full corpus) have zero resolvable evidence -- dataset-inherent (J.2 finding), never converted to a fabricated gold set.
Not registered under the frozen phase3/evaluation/datasets/profile.schema.json (dataset_id enum locked to the 4 canonical-active datasets) -- a shape-compatible sibling profile.

evidence_notes.claim: 97.0% of evidence spans resolve via the J.2 deterministic waterfall (full-corpus scan).
conversations[i].id is globally unique (0 reuse across 74,391+ conversations checked).
